title: Oral Comprehension — Understanding Spoken Language
description: Oral comprehension is the ability to listen and understand spoken words and sentences — the foundation of every briefing, lecture, negotiation, and bedtime story. It is among the most demanded cognitive abilities across occupations in the O*NET database, and it improves with deliberate practice: active listening, note-taking, and playback.

title: Deductive Reasoning — From Rules to Conclusions
description: Deductive reasoning applies general rules to specific cases to reach certain conclusions: all men are mortal, Socrates is a man, therefore Socrates is mortal. It powers troubleshooting, mathematics, law, and debugging — anywhere valid conclusions must follow from premises. Its discipline is checking the premises, because valid logic on false premises manufactures confident errors.

title: Static Strength — Maximum Force
description: Static strength is the maximum force exertable in a single effort — the deadlift, the stuck-door shove, the carry.
